propositions.text: The decision owner retained final approval authority.
A consultation process was offered before implementation.
Participants may have had advisory voice without equivalent decision power.

mechanisms.label: meaningful influence constrained by unequal decision authority
mechanisms.causalDirection: final approval authority -> limited practical influence

mechanisms.label: time pressure limits deliberation
mechanisms.causalDirection: implementation pressure -> fewer opportunities to revise
